# Clinical Schizophrenia & Related Psychoses

> A SCOPUS-indexed peer-reviewed journal publishing clinical research on schizophrenia diagnosis, treatment, and related psychotic disorders.

Edited by Peter F. Buckley and published by Walsh Medical Media, LLC, this journal serves clinicians and researchers in psychiatric medicine. The journal is indexed in major medical databases including PubMed and SCOPUS, and maintains rigorous peer-review standards for all submissions.

## Key Topics

- [Clinical Schizophrenia & Related Psychoses | Indexing and Archiving](https://www.clinicalschizophrenia.net/indexing.html): Indexing in Medline, PubMed, and other medical databases
- [Clinical Schizophrenia & Related Psychoses | Citations Report](https://www.clinicalschizophrenia.net/citations.html): Journal impact metrics, h-index, and citation analytics
